discardedFrameExplorations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent birthday UI frame for a modal, drawer, bottom sheet and detail card. Design a square ornamental perimeter frame on a truly transparent background, with a completely transparent large interior window. Style: Warm ivory, rich oxblood burgundy silk, champagne-gold metal. Exquisite sculptural editorial birthday craft, restrained mature luxury, realistic satin fabric and fine-gold detail. Frame structure: very fine graceful lines along all four edges, with carefully crafted birthday ornaments concentrated INSIDE the four corner squares, each within the outermost 16 percent of the image. Top-left and bottom-right have the richer small birthday ribbon/gift/candle motifs; other corners lighter. Keep the middle 60 percent of EACH edge as a simple continuous thin line with no large ornaments, so the frame can be nine-slice scaled without distorting decorative objects. The central 65 percent square must be entirely empty transparent alpha. No colored background, no paper panel, no shadow behind the whole image, no checkerboard painted into the image. At least 3 percent transparent outer margin, entire frame visible, not cut off. No text, no lettering, no logos, no UI controls, no watermark. Premium restrained craftsmanship, crisp silhouette, balanced corner detail, square composition.
